theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {I : C} [CategoryTheory.Injective I] {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ} (ι : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I ⟶ L) [L.IsStrictlyGE i] [QuasiIsoAt ι i] : CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono ι := by
  let K := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I
  have hK_injective : ∀ n, CategoryTheory.Injective (K.X n) :=
    by intro n; exact CategoryTheory.Injective.comp (CochainComplex.singleFunctor.obj_map.Injective I) (CochainComplex.singleFunctor.obj_map.Injective I)
  have hL_K_injective : CochainComplex.IsKInjective L :=
    CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective L (by apply_instance)
  have h_quasi_iso : QuasiIso ι :=
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective.quasiIso_iff L (by apply_instance) (by apply_instance) (QuasiIso.mk ι (by apply_instance))
  have h_quasi_iso_at : QuasiIsoAt ι i :=
    QuasiIso.quasiIsoAt h_quasi_iso
  constructor
  apply CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono.of_quasiIso_at_and_injective
  exact h_quasi_iso_at
  exact (by apply_instance)
